title: You Are Not Half of Anyone
core_idea: Even within the twin flame belief, a healthy bond can be seen as a meeting of two whole people, respecting freedom and boundaries, not a rescue.
text: One of the most common ideas around twin flames is that a single soul was split in two. It's a beautiful image, and many people find meaning in it. But it can quietly suggest that you're incomplete until someone else arrives. Perhaps there's a gentler way to hold it. Even within this belief, many describe the deepest connections as meetings between two whole people, each standing on their own ground. A bond like that doesn't ask you to disappear into it. It respects your time, your boundaries and your freedom to walk away. If a connection feels meaningful, let it be a meeting, not a rescue. You were already whole before anyone saw you.
description: A reflection on the twin flame idea that honours wholeness, freedom and healthy boundaries over the feeling of being incomplete.
